$comment: Credentials that are intentionally public in a static site must be declared here with a reason. Each entry keeps the finding visible in CI output instead of hiding it. Anything listed here must be restricted in its provider console (HTTP referrer allowlist + minimum API scopes); see SECURITY.md.

index.html.reason: Google Maps JavaScript API browser key. Browser API keys are public by design and must be locked down in the Google Cloud console (HTTP referrer allowlist, Maps JS API only). The SDK is now loaded only after the visitor opts in, so the key is not even requested on page load.

README.md.reason: Documentation of the key rotation procedure; see SECURITY.md.
